mapper.select: SELECT sa.artist_id, sa.similar_artist_id, a.name AS similar_artist_name, sa.lastfm_score, sa.computed_score, sa.source FROM similar_artists sa JOIN artists a ON a.id = sa.similar_artist_id WHERE sa.artist_id = #{artistId} ORDER BY sa.lastfm_score DESC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO similar_artists (artist_id, similar_artist_id, lastfm_score, source) VALUES
(#{sa.artistId}, #{sa.similarArtistId}, #{sa.lastfmScore}, #{sa.source})
mapper.update: UPDATE similar_artists SET computed_score = ( SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF( (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tag_name) FROM artist_tags WHERE artist_id = similar_artists.artist_id) + (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tag_name) FROM artist_tags WHERE artist_id = similar_artists.similar_artist_id) - COUNT(*), 0 ) FROM artist_tags x JOIN artist_tags y ON x.tag_name = y.tag_name AND x.artist_id = similar_artists.artist_id AND y.artist_id = similar_artists.similar_artist_id ) WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM artist_tags WHERE artist_id = similar_artists.artist_id )
